nom: medicube Hypochlorous Acid Daily Facial Spray

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report zero irritation and a calming, refreshing effect when used after cleansing.
segments.mature: One reviewer going through menopause reports severe acne, perioral dermatitis, and itchy ears, and describes this spray as part of a combo that nearly cleared her face within a week.

concerns.redness: Reviewers report the spray calms redness and irritation quickly, including rosacea flares, with no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with perioral dermatitis and rash-like irritation reports the spray helped disinfect and heal these areas alongside other products.
concerns.spots: Reviewers use the spray to disinfect and prevent new breakouts, including body acne and hormonal acne, with one describing near-complete clearing of picked/irritated acne spots within a week.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report the spray helps stop new acne from forming or calms breakouts once they occur; no reviewer reports worsened breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Easy to fit into daily routine

extraits.texte: So, I was skeptical about hopping on the Medicube train and waited a LONG time...TOO long!! My skin has been rebelling and breaking out terribly since I hit menopause! Plus, my ear started itching and I thought something else was wrong with me. It's a menopause thing, too! Menopause has really wreaked havoc on my face! Not only did I develop the worst acne that I've ever had, but I also started getting pretty bad perioral dermatitis from my steroid inhaler, which I've used forever, and my ear started frequently itching. I went to the doctors, and he put me on oral antibiotics for 30 days, which kinda helped, but things got worse when I stopped them. He looked in my ear and said they looked normal. So, that was not very helpful. I didn't want to take antibiotics long-term, which led me to do some research and brought me to Medicube. I bought several of their products at once, and now I'm hooked! This spray is incredible alone, because it's great at disinfecting wounds, healing rashes, itchy menopause ears, and killing acne-causing bacteria after you've washed your face, and before you do any other steps in your beauty routine. But, when I use it on my face in conjunction with Mediheal (not a sp error) Madecassoside blemish serum or blemish pads, and Medicubes Cica pads for the red, irritated, or raw spots that I caused by picking at my acne or dermatitis, it's a powerhouse combo! reserve: Only six reviews are available, all rated 5/5, so no critical or lower-rated perspective could be included and conclusions rest on a small, uniformly positive sample.
